subject: snapshot_patches
text: `snapshot_patches` (src/git/diff.rs L111-L198) covers at most `max_entries` paths by iterating the caller-supplied entries in their given order (`for entry in entries.iter().take(max_entries)`), and its doc contract requires `entries` to be the already-sorted output of `snapshot_diff`.
